verdict.rationale: The MI325X is hardware that customers deploy in their own infrastructure. First-party Instinct docs cover the self-hosted path: a Customer Acceptance Guide to configure, validate and baseline GPUs, a Cluster Validation Suite, a Kubernetes GPU Operator and device plugin, a container toolkit, and SMI management tools. All of this sits on the open-source ROCm stack with vLLM and SGLang inference recipes. A community comment doubting availability to ordinary buyers is speculation rather than a documented failure, and another comment cites a purchase price of around $15k, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: first-party procurement or on-prem purchase documentation (the vendor product page was unreachable), and independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted MI325X deployment.
